BEGIN;
DROP TRIGGER trg_project_authoring_staging_immutable ON project_authoring_flow;
DROP FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_staging_mutation();
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_staging_receipt;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_status;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_status CHECK(status IN ('PROPOSED','CONFIRMED','AUTHORING','READY','PUBLISHED','FAILED'));
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_status;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_status CHECK(tz_job_status IS NULL OR tz_job_status IN ('PLANNED','GENERATING','VERIFYING','READY','FAILED'));
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_state_shape;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_state_shape CHECK(
        status='FAILED'
        OR (status='PROPOSED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='CONFIRMED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='AUTHORING' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='READY' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='PUBLISHED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
    );
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP COLUMN staging_receipt_json;
COMMIT;
